questions.q: If the radius of a circle is decreased by $35\%$ then its area decreases by?
questions.s: Dekh bhai, jab bhi area me change ho aur radius me decrease ho, AB rule (Successive) lagta hai: $x + y - \frac{xy}{100}$. Area $= \pi r^2$, isliye do baar $-35\%$ hoga. Net change $= 35 + 35 - \frac{35 \times 35}{100} = 70 - 12.25 = 57.75\%$. Ab options ko dhyan se dekh, $57.75$ ko fraction me $57 \frac{3}{4}\%$ bolte hain. Examiner ne sirf decimal ko fraction me badal ke daraya hai!

questions.q: The radius of the base of a right circular cylinder is increased by $20\%$. By what percent should its height be reduced so that its volume remains the same as before?
questions.s: Dekh bhai aise karna hai... Cylinder ka volume $V = \pi r^2 h$ hota hai. Agar Volume constant rakhna hai, toh height $h \propto \frac{1}{r^2}$ hogi. Radius $20\%$ ($1/5$) se badha, yani 5 se 6 hua. Toh $r^2$ ka ratio 25 se 36 ho gaya. Height ko iska ulta hona padega, yani 36 se 25! Kitni kami aayi? 11 ki kami aayi 36 par. Percent change $= \frac{11}{36} \times 100 = \frac{1100}{36} = \frac{275}{9} = 30 \frac{5}{9}\%$. Base strong rakho bas!

questions.q: If decreasing 80 by $x\%$ gives the same result as increasing 16 by $x\%$, then $x\%$ of 120 is how much percentage more than $33.33\%$ of 210?
questions.s: Dekh bhai, lamba question hai par tod tod ke padh. $80(1 - \frac{x}{100}) = 16(1 + \frac{x}{100})$. 16 se 80 ko kaat do 5 baar. $5 - \frac{5x}{100} = 1 + \frac{x}{100} \implies \frac{6x}{100} = 4 \implies x = \frac{400}{6} = 66.66\%$. Ab agla part: $x\%$ of 120 yani $66.66\%$ ($\frac{2}{3}$) of 120 = 80. Dusra number: $33.33\%$ ($\frac{1}{3}$) of 210 = 70. Pucha hai 80, 70 se kitna zyada hai? 10 zyada hai 70 pe. $\frac{10}{70} = \frac{1}{7}$. $\frac{1}{7}$ ka standard fraction value $14.28\%$ hota hai.

questions.q: The income of A is 5080 per month. he saves $40\%$ of his income. If his monthly income increases by $20\%$ and expenditure increases by $30\%$ then his monthly savings increase by?
questions.s: Dekh bhai, 5080 ki koi zaroorat nahi hai pehle step me! JSM laga. Savings $40\%$ hai, toh Exp $60\%$ hua. Exp : Sav = $3 : 2$. Total Income $5$ unit. Equation: $5 \times 20 = 3 \times 30 + 2 \times x \implies 100 = 90 + 2x \implies x = 5\%$. Yani savings me sirf $5\%$ ka increase hua hai. Original saving kitni thi? $5080$ ka $40\% = 2032$. Nayi saving $5\%$ zyada hai, toh $2032$ ka $5\%$ (yani $\frac{1}{20}$) nikalna hai. $2032 / 20 = 101.6$. Answer done!

questions.q: Last year in CAT, each section of the question paper had different weightage. The weightage of QA, DI and VA/RC sections were 8, 9 and 10 respectively. The maximum marks in all the three sections together was 810. Wrong answer did not carry negative marks as a penalty. If Padma had gotten $20\%$ more marks in QA and $8\%$ more marks in DI and $7.14\dots\%$ more marks in VA/RC, then she must had gotten $100\%$ marks in all the three sections. The total marks that Padma had scored:
questions.s: Dekh bhai, weightage ratio $8:9:10$ hai aur total sum 810. Yani $27\text{ units} = 810 \implies 1\text{ unit} = 30$. Toh max marks section wise hue: QA=240, DI=270, VA=300. Ab ulta chalo. Agar vo itne % zyada laati tab $100\%$ (yani max) marks aate. Toh purane marks: QA me usko mila $\frac{240}{1.2} = 200$. DI me usko mila $\frac{270}{1.08} = 250$. VA me $7.14\% = \frac{1}{14}$ zyada aate tab full aate, yani uska score $\frac{14}{15}$ of 300 = 280 raha hoga. Total marks usne kitne paye? $200 + 250 + 280 = 730$. Language bhayankar thi, question lallu tha.

questions.q: In a cricket series, Team A had a winning rate of $70\%$ after playing x matches. Then they lost 20 matches consecutively, and their winning rate fell to $50\%$. Find the total matches played by Team A before the losing streak?
questions.s: Dekh bhai, Alligation ka super hit use! Pehle winning rate $70\%$. Agle 20 match haare, yani inme winning rate $0\%$. Dono ko mix kiya toh overall winning rate $50\%$ ho gaya. Ratio nikal: $(50-0) : (70-50) = 50 : 20 = 5 : 2$. Yani pehle khele matches aur baad me khele matches ka ratio $5:2$ hona chahiye. Hame baad ke matches ki ginti 20 de rakhi hai (yani 2 unit = 20). Toh initial matches (5 unit) honge 50. Game Over!

questions.q: In measuring the sides of a rectangle, errors of $10\%$ and $8\%$ in excess are made. Find the error percent in its area.
questions.s: Dekh bhai, Area $L \times B$ hota hai. Jab dono dimensions me lagatar % change ho, toh AB Rule lagao. $+10\%$ aur $+8\%$. Net change $= 10 + 8 + \frac{10 \times 8}{100} = 18 + 0.8 = 18.8\%$. Pen chalao toh dimaag pehle chalna chahiye!

questions.q: Every month, a man consumes 15 kg of rice and 6 kg of wheat. The price of rice is $20\%$ of the price of wheat, resulting in a total expenditure of 225 per month for rice and wheat combined. If the price of wheat is increased by $12\%$, what percentage reduction in rice consumption is needed to maintain the same expenditure of 225? (Given that price of rice and consumption of wheat is constant)
questions.s: Dekh bhai, Price of Rice $20\%$ of Wheat hai, yani R:W price ratio $1:5$. Maan le Rice Rs. x/kg, Wheat Rs. 5x/kg. Total kharcha: $15(x) + 6(5x) = 45x = 225 \implies x=5$. Toh Rice = 5 Rs/kg, Wheat = 25 Rs/kg. Ab Wheat price 12% bada, yani $25 \times 0.12 = 3$ Rs badha. 6 kg wheat pe $3 \times 6 = 18$ Rs ka extra kharcha aayega. Par usko kharcha 225 hi rakhna hai. Toh ye 18 Rs usko Rice kam kharid ke bachaane padenge. 1 kg Rice 5 Rs ka hai. Toh wo $\frac{18}{5} = 3.6$ kg rice kam lega. Original consumption 15 kg thi. % reduction = $(\frac{3.6}{15}) \times 100 = 24\%$. Concept clarity chahiye yahan!

questions.q: If $7\%$ of a number is 21, what is the value of the number minus $25\%$ of itself? (PHASE XIII(GRAD) - $\frac{30}{07}$/2025 - SHIFT 3)
questions.s: Dekh bhai aise karna hai... Agar kisi number ka $7\% = 21$ hai, toh $1\% = 3$ hoga. Pucha hai number me se uska $25\%$ ghata de, yani number ka $75\%$ chahiye. $1\% = 3$ hai toh $75\% = 75 \times 3 = 225$ hoga. Pura number 300 nikal ke usme se 75 ghatana murkhta hai, direct percentage me khelo!

questions.q: The prime cost of an article is thrice of raw material. If the cost of raw material is increased in the ratio 5:12 and cost of manufacturing expenses is increased in the ratio 4:5. If the initial cost is 6 then find the final cost?
questions.s: Dekh bhai, Prime Cost = Raw Material + Manufacturing. Initial prime cost 6 di hai, jo Raw ka 3 guna hai. Yani RM = 2, toh Mfg = 4 hoga (Tabhi $2+4=6$ banega). RM 5:12 me badha, yani agar RM pehle 5 tha toh 12 hua, yahan 2 tha toh $\frac{12}{5} \times 2 = 4.8$ ho jayega. Mfg 4:5 me badha, yani 4 tha toh 5 ho jayega. Nayi Final Cost = Naya RM + Naya Mfg = $4.8 + 5 = 9.8$. Seedha aur sateek!

questions.q: In an examination, $52\%$ of the candidates failed in English and $42\%$ failed in Mathematics. If $17\%$ failed in both the subjects, then the percentage of candidates who passed in both the subjects was?
questions.s: Dekh bhai, Set theory ka bahut basic sawal. Total fail nikal: Fail in Eng + Fail in Math - Fail in Both. Yani $52 + 42 - 17 = 94 - 17 = 77\%$. Total $77\%$ log kisi na kisi subject me fail hue hain. Toh pass kitne hue dono me? Total $100\%$ me se in fail hone walo ko nikal de. $100 - 77 = 23\%$. Options ko dekho aur tick maro!

questions.q: Income of a person increases by $x\%$ and $x/2\%$ during first and third year but decreases by $x\%$ and $x/2\%$ 2nd year and 4th year respectively if the total decrement during four year is $\text{Rs. } 3340.8$. then find the initial income of person if during first two-year, total salary decreases by $36\%$
questions.s: Dekh bhai, thoda bada question hai, break karke padh! Pehle do saal: $+x\%$ aur $-x\%$. Result kya hoga? $- \frac{x^2}{100}\%$ ka net decrease. Ye value $36\%$ di hui hai. Toh $x^2/100 = 36 \implies x = 60\%$. Teesra aur chautha saal: $x/2 = 30\%$ se badha aur fir $30\%$ ghata. Iska net decrease hoga $- \frac{30^2}{100} = -9\%$. Charo saal ka overall successive lagega: $36\%$ decrease aur $9\%$ decrease ka. $(0.64) \times (0.91) = 0.5824$ bacha! Decrease kitna hua? $1 - 0.5824 = 0.4176$ (yani $41.76\%$). $41.76\%$ of Salary = $3340.8$. Isko solve karega toh Salary $8000$ ayegi.

questions.q: Two numbers are respectively $20\%$ less and $30\%$ more than a third number. What is the ratio of the two numbers? (CHSL TIER I- $\frac{12}{11}$/2025-SHIFT 2)
questions.s: Dekh bhai, ye free ke number hain! Third number ko aakhe band kar ke $100$ maan le. Pehla number $20\%$ kam hai, yani $80$ ho gaya. Dusra number $30\%$ zyada hai, yani $130$ ho gaya. Pucha kya hai? Pehle aur dusre ka ratio! $80 : 130$. Dono ka zero uda de, $8:13$ aa gaya. Bawal trick!

questions.q: 10,000 voters vote to elect their mayor. A receives 500 votes more than that of B and wins the election. $5\%$ of the votes are invalid. If a news TV channel predicts that after 5 years the number of voters will increase by $50\%$ and A will receive $10\%$ votes less than that he received now, how many votes will B get at that time? (Assume all the votes as valid after 5 years and only A and B stand in the election in both the time)
questions.s: Dekh bhai, present ka data nikalte hain pehle. 10,000 ka $5\%$ yani $500$ vote khrab ho gaye. Valid bache $9500$. Equation: $A + B = 9500$ aur margin $A - B = 500$. Dono add kar de: $2A = 10000 \implies A = 5000$. Toh B ko abhi $4500$ mile hain. TV prediction 5 saal baad ki: Total voter $50\%$ badh kar 15000 ho jayenge (aur sab valid hain). A ko is baar $10\%$ kam (yani $5000$ ka $90\% = 4500$) milenge. B ke vote nikalne ke liye total me se A ke hata de: $15000 - 4500 = 10500$. Aaram se solve hota hai.

questions.q: If the price of petrol increased by $6\%$, then by what percentage should the consumption be decreased by the consumer, if the expenditure on petrol remains unchanged?
questions.s: Dekh bhai, jab expenditure constant hota hai, Price aur Consumption inversely related hote hain! Price $6\%$ badha yani $100$ se $106$ hua. Ratio $50:53$. Toh Consumption ko $53$ se $50$ pe aana padega. Kami kitni karni padi? 3 ki, 53 par. Percentage me $= \frac{3}{53} \times 100 = \frac{300}{53}$. Ab $53 \times 5 = 265$ hota hai, toh answer $5.algo$ hoga. Options pass hain. Divide karenge toh $5.66\%$ tak jayega. Approximation works well here!

questions.q: A fraction in reduced form is such that when it is squared and then its numerator is increased by $25\%$ and the denominator is reduced to $80\%$ it results in $\frac{5}{8}$ of the original fraction. The product of the numerator and denominator is:
questions.s: Dekh bhai, maan le original fraction $\frac{N}{D}$ hai. Iska square kiya: $\frac{N^2}{D^2}$. Numerator ko $25\%$ badhaya yani $\frac{5}{4}$ kiya. Denominator ko $80\%$ kiya yani $\frac{4}{5}$ kiya. Toh Naya fraction bana: $\frac{\frac{5}{4} N^2}{\frac{4}{5} D^2} = \frac{25 N^2}{16 D^2}$. Question kehta hai ki ye value original fraction ka $\frac{5}{8}$ hai. Yani $\frac{25 N^2}{16 D^2} = \frac{5}{8} \frac{N}{D}$. Ek $\frac{N}{D}$ cancel ho jayega. Bacha $\frac{N}{D} = \frac{5}{8} \times \frac{16}{25} = \frac{2}{5}$. Toh fraction $\frac{2}{5}$ tha. Pucha inka product: $2 \times 5 = 10$. Option match kar lo.

questions.q: The number of students in A is (y + 63) which is 47 less than that of B. If the number of boys in B is $\frac{1}{3}$ of the total number of students in B and the number of girls in B is $75\%$ of the total number of students in A, then find the total number of students in B?
questions.s: Dekh bhai, isme variables se bachke sirf B par dhyan de. B me boys total ka $\frac{1}{3}$ hain, toh girls B ka $\frac{2}{3}$ hongi. B ki girls $75\%$ ($\frac{3}{4}$) of A ke barabar hain. Yani $\frac{2}{3}B = \frac{3}{4}A$. Hamein pehli line me diya hai $A = B - 47$. Daal isme: $\frac{2}{3}B = \frac{3}{4}(B - 47)$. Cross multiply: $8B = 9B - 423 \implies B = 423$. Options me 423 hai!

questions.q: Bag A contains x balls and the number of balls in Bag B is $20\%$ more than that of Bag A and the number of balls in Bag C is (x + 15)% more than that of Bag B. If the total number of balls in Bag B and C is 27, find the value of (x*3+10).
questions.s: Dekh bhai, logically soch isko. B aur C ki ginti total 27 de rakhi hai. Ye balls hamesha integer hongi, adhuri ball toh hogi nahi. B, A se $20\%$ (1/5) zyada hai, yani A kam se kam 5 ka multiple hona chahiye. Agar A = 10 ho, toh B = 12. C jo hai wo B se $(10+15)\%$ yani $25\%$ (1/4) zyada hoga. B(12) ka $25\%$ 3 hota hai, toh C = 15. Total B+C = $12+15=27$. Match ho gaya! Matlam x = 10 bilkul sahi socha hai. Pucha hai: $x \times 3 + 10 = 10 \times 3 + 10 = 40$. Common sense rocks!

questions.q: If a student multiplied a number by $\frac{6}{11}$ instead of $\frac{5}{6}$ find the % error in the calculation?
questions.s: Dekh bhai aise karna hai... Denominators ka LCM pakad le! 11 aur 6 ka LCM 66. Maan le original number 66 hai. Sahi result aana tha: $66 \times \frac{5}{6} = 55$. Galati se result kya aaya: $66 \times \frac{6}{11} = 36$. Error kitne ka hua? $55 - 36 = 19$. Error humesha asli value (55) pe niklega. % Error = $(\frac{19}{55}) \times 100$. Ab isko solve karenge toh $34.54\%$ ke aspas aayega. Exact fraction hoga $34 \frac{6}{11}\%$. Trick follow kar, number khud bolenge!

questions.q: A fruit seller sells $45\%$ of the oranges that he has along with one more orange to a customer. He then sells $20\%$ of the remaining oranges and 2 more oranges to a second customer. He then sells $90\%$ of the now remaining oranges to a third customer and is still left with 5 oranges. How many oranges did the fruit seller have initially?
questions.s: Dekh bhai, isey peeche se aage ki taraf solve kar (Reverse Line Method). C3 ko $90\%$ becha aur fir bhi 5 bache hain. Yani jo $10\%$ bacha uski value 5 hai. Toh C3 ke aane se theek pehle total $50$ oranges the. C2 ke time: usne $20\%$ beche aur 2 extra diye. Agar 2 extra nahi diye hote, toh $50+2=52$ hote. Ye 52, remaining ka $80\%$ the. Toh C2 ke aane se pehle total = $52 / 0.8 = 65$ the. C1 ke time: usne $45\%$ beche aur 1 extra diya. Agar 1 extra nahi diya hota, toh $65+1=66$ bachte, jo initial ka $55\%$ hote. Toh Initial Total = $66 / 0.55 = 120$. Piche se socho, asaan padega.

questions.q: The population of a village was 12650. If the males and females are increased by $7\%$ and $5\%$. The population will become 13409 after 1 year. Find the number of males at present.
questions.s: Dekh bhai, JSM ka baap method. Population kitni badhi? $13409 - 12650 = 759$. Maan le sab log (Male aur Female dono) minimal base yaani $5\%$ se badhte, toh total increase kitna hota? $12650 \times 5\% = 632.5$. Par asli increase 759 hai. Ye extra $(759 - 632.5 = 126.5)$ kahan se aaya? Ye extra increase un bache hue $2\%$ males (kyunki $7\% = 5\% + 2\%$) ki wajah se hai. Toh Males ka $2\% = 126.5$ hai. Males $100\% = 126.5 \times 50 = 6325$. Ekdum makkhan approach!

questions.q: A number is divided into two parts in such a way that $75\%$ of the first part is 6 more than $90\%$ of the second part and $80\%$ of the second part is 12 more than $45\%$ of the first part. Then the number is?
questions.s: Dekh bhai, equations banane padenge par fast. Parts ko P aur Q maan le. Eq1: $0.75P - 0.9Q = 6$. Eq2: $0.8Q - 0.45P = 12$. Decimal hata de ease ke liye. Eq1: $75P - 90Q = 600$ (divide by 15 kar $\implies 5P - 6Q = 40$). Eq2: $80Q - 45P = 1200$ (divide by 5 kar $\implies 16Q - 9P = 240$). Ab pehli eq ko 9 se aur dusri ko 5 se multiply karke add kar de P eliminate ho jayega! $-54Q + 80Q = 360 + 1200 \implies 26Q = 1560 \implies Q = 60$. Q ki value P me daal de, $P = 80$ aa jayega. Total Number $= 80 + 60 = 140$. Mazboot pakad chahiye algebra pe.

questions.q: Varun gave $60\%$ of the money he had to his wife. He also gave $20\%$ of the remaining amount to each of his three children. Three-fifth of the amount now left was spent on miscellaneous items, and the remaining amount of $\text{Rs. } 9,600$ was deposited in the bank. How much money did Varun have initially?:
questions.s: Dekh bhai, tree method ya successive line dono se chalega! Initial amount ko 100 maan le. 60 wife ko de diya, bacha 40. Ab dhyan de '20% to each of his three children' yani total 60% of remaining (40) usne bacchon ko diya. Toh 40 ka 60% = 24 de diya. Ab bacha $40 - 24 = 16$. Is 16 me se 'Three-fifth' (yani $\frac{3}{5}$) usne miscellaneous me udha diya. Bank me jama kiya bacha hua $\frac{2}{5}$ hissa. $16 \times \frac{2}{5} = 6.4$ unit. Question ke hisab se $6.4$ unit = 9600. Pucha 100 unit hai. $\frac{9600}{6.4} \times 100 = 1500 \times 100 = 1,50,000$. Jhaanse me mat aana 'each of his three children' wali line se!

questions.q: After two successive increments, a person's salary became $156.25\%$ of the original salary. If the percentage increase in the second increment was equal to that in the first increment, then what was the percentage of each increment?
questions.s: Dekh bhai, successive me jab barabar increment ho 2 baar toh seedha Compound Interest wala Square Root concept lagta hai! Salary initial $100\%$ thi ab $156.25\%$ ho gayi. Ratio nikal: $156.25 / 100 = 1.5625$. Iska square root nikal do! $\sqrt{1.5625} = 1.25$. Yani har saal ka multiplier $1.25$ tha. $1$ pe $0.25$ ki badhotri ka sidha matalab hai ki $25\%$ ka increment tha har stage pe. Pen free question!

questions.q: The value of a machine depreciates by $10\%$ per annum. If its present value is $\text{Rs. } 72,900$, find its value 2 years ago. (PHASE XIII(HS) - $\frac{02}{08}$/2025 - SHIFT 2)
questions.s: Dekh bhai, simple successive depreciation hai. $10\%$ kam hona yani value $\frac{9}{10}$ bachna. 2 saal ka case hai toh equation banegi: $\text{Old Value} \times (\frac{9}{10})^2 = \text{New Value}$. $\text{Old Value} \times \frac{81}{100} = 72,900$. 81 se 729 seedha 9 bar me katta hai! Toh $\text{Old Value} = 900 \times 100 = 90,000$. Examiner ne data calculations aasan di hain taaki speed test ho!
